item.title: As election race heats up, Vancouver mayoral candidate pitches plan to keep homes cool
item.description: Vancouver mayoral candidate Amanda Burrows says she'd work with partners to retrofit housing stock in Vancouver with heat pumps.

item.title: A small Alberta village could be no more as viability review ramps up
item.description: A small village in central Alberta could lose its municipal status after a provincial viability review began in July 2025.

item.title: Vancouver links to ICE revealed with protest expected today
item.description: Over the past week, alleged connections between Vancouver and ICE have been revealed, and a protest has been planned in response.

item.title: Air Canada is sending Canadian athletes and their families to the Milano Cortina Olympics to go for gold
item.description: Air Canada is hosting an Olympic send-off celebration at Montréal-Trudeau Airport as the road to Milano Cortina 2026 begins for Team Canada.

item.title: Canadian Olympic athlete first tried her sport eight months ago after a random DM
item.description: Becoming an Olympic athlete takes years of dedication and sacrifice in a particular sport. Unless your name is Kelsey Mitchell.

item.title: It’s official: Pete Fry is the Green party’s first Vancouver mayoral candidate in 30 years
item.description: Pete Fry is officially the Green Party of Vancouver's mayoral candidate in the October 2026 civic election.

item.title: The Boathouse Restaurant to close Port Moody location after nearly 20 years
item.description: After nearly 20 years of operation, The Boathouse Restaurant will be closing its Port Moody location after a corporation bought the space.

item.title: Beloved Vancouver music store closes down last shop
item.description: Rufus Guitar and Drum Shop, a store beloved by local musicians, is closing its last location on Commercial Drive

item.title: New landmark tree-inspired office tower concept proposed for revived Waterfront Station project
item.description: Cadillac Fairview has rebooted its 601 West Cordova St. (555 West Cordova St.) office tower proposal at Waterfront Station with a new design.

item.title: Vancouver Canucks player hilariously trolls Elias Pettersson in a media scrum
item.description: The Vancouver Canucks and fun haven't exactly gone together much this year. But it has been a relatively fun last 48 hours.
